# Security Policy

## Supported versions

The latest `main` branch and the newest release tag receive security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Open a private security advisory via GitHub ("Security" tab > "Report a vulnerability"), or email the address on the repository About page. Please do not open a public issue for exploitable problems.

Include: affected file or skill, a minimal reproduction, and the impact you observed. You will get an initial response within 7 days.

## Scope

This repository ships prompts, agents, commands, and scripts intended to run with your full permissions. Review anything you install, and do not run skill scripts from untrusted sources without reading them first.
